segments.contextAfter: `EXC_ARM_DA_ALIGN`. The crashed thread tried to access memory that isn’t appropriately aligned. This exception code is rare because 64-bit ARM CPUs work with misaligned data. However, you may see this exception subtype if the memory address is both misaligned and located in an unmapped memory region. You may have other crash reports that show a memory access issue with a different exception subtype, which are likely caused by the same underlying memory access issue.
